# Theme M1 — Local Setup GuideMixed multi-domain orchestrator (HR + Finance + Ops portals).  Produces aligned GT logs for UIA AutoSeg V2 evaluation.---## Prerequisites| Requirement | Notes ||---|---|| Python 3.11+ | Must be on PATH or at a standard install location || Google Chrome | Standard install at `C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\` || ProcMine Desktop Agent | Must be running and recording before you start a session || ProcMine Browser Extension | Unpacked extension folder (one-time Chrome setup below) || Microsoft Excel | Optional — lookup steps are skipped if absent |> Teams, Outlook, and OneNote are **not required**. The orchestrator skips those noise steps automatically if the apps are not present.---## 1. Clone and install dependencies```powershellgit clone https://github.com/I-mBesideYou/procmine-test-sets.gitcd procmine-test-sets/Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automationpip install pyautogui websocket-client```---## 2. One-time browser extension setupThe ProcMine browser extension captures browser navigation, clicks, and form inputs (L3 events). It must be loaded into each of the three Chrome portal windows once. After that it persists in the Chrome profiles stored at `theme_m1_data/chrome-profiles/` and loads automatically on every future run.**Step 1 — Get the extension**Download `procmine-extension-v1.0.0.zip` from the team drive and unzip it. Note the path to the unpacked folder (e.g. `C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension\`).**Step 2 — Run the one-time setup script**```powershellcd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation$chrome = "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"$base   = "$PSScriptRoot\..\..\chrome-profiles"   # created automatically$ext    = "C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension"  # your path# Kill any existing Chrome, then open one window per portaltaskkill /F /IM chrome.exe 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2foreach ($entry in @(    @{dir="m1-hr";      url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"},    @{dir="m1-finance"; url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"},    @{dir="m1-ops";     url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"})) {    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$base\$($entry.dir)" | Out-Null    Start-Process $chrome -ArgumentList "--user-data-dir=`"$base\$($entry.dir)`"","--no-first-run","--new-window",$entry.url    Start-Sleep 3}```> The portals won't load (no http.server running yet) — that's fine. You just need Chrome open with each profile.**Step 3 — Load the extension in each window**In each of the 3 Chrome windows:1. Open a new tab → navigate to `chrome://extensions`2. Enable **Developer mode** (toggle, top-right)3. Click **Load unpacked** → select the `procmine-extension` folder4. Confirm extension ID `gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn` appears5. Close the extensions tab**Step 4 — Close all Chrome windows**The extension is now saved to each profile. You're done — don't repeat this unless you delete `chrome-profiles/`.---## 3. Running a session**Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent first** and confirm it is recording.Then run either launcher:```powershell# PowerShell launcher (interactive prompts)cd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation.\launch_m1.ps1# Or Python launcher (same behaviour, cross-platform args)python scripts/run_theme_m1.pypython scripts/run_theme_m1.py --seed 42 --speed 1 --scale 2```### Run parameters| Prompt / Flag | Values | Default ||---|---|---|| Seed | Any integer | Random || Speed | `1` = fast (0.4×) · `2` = normal (1.4×) | `2` || Scale | `1` = 5–7 procs · `2` = 8–10 · `3` = 11–14 | `2` || Date | `YYYY-MM-DD` | Today |Pre-set with env vars to skip prompts:```powershell$env:M1_SEED = "42"; $env:M1_SPEED = "1"; $env:M1_SCALE = "2".\launch_m1.ps1```### What launches- 3 Python `http.server` instances (ports 5122 / 5123 / 5124)- Notepad- Excel with `documents/m1_reference.xlsx` (if available)- 3 Chrome windows (HR / Finance / Ops portals), each with CDP and ProcMine extension### Extension checkThe launcher prints one of:```[OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured``````[warn] Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: ...```If you see the warn, do the one-time extension setup (section 2) before continuing.---## 4. OutputAfter the run, GT logs land in:```Mixed/theme_m1_data/gt-logs/  theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl```Raw chunk arrives in S3 a few minutes after the session ends (desktop agent uploads asynchronously).---## 5. Per-chunk delivery packageOnce the chunk is in S3, generate the delivery package manually:```bashpython scripts/gen_chunk_package.py \  --gt    gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --out   gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_package \  --events   /path/to/downloaded/events.jsonl \  --manifest /path/to/downloaded/manifest.json \  --s3-prefix s3://procmine-app/chunks/<uid>/<chunk_id>/```Then run the official self-check:```bashpython C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py \  --events-jsonl /path/to/events.jsonl \  --manifest     /path/to/manifest.json \  --gt-jsonl     gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --no-run-pipeline --summary-only --pretty```Minimum pass criteria (from handoff doc section 4.4):```guardrails.status = pass (or warn)guardrails.failures = []manifest_event_line_count == actual event_count: OKGT/raw timestamp overlap: high (≥ 90%)```---## 6. Folder layout after setup```Mixed/theme_m1_data/  process_automation/       <- launchers and scripts    launch_m1.ps1    scripts/      orchestrator_m1.py      run_theme_m1.py      gen_chunk_package.py      uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py    tools/      hr-portal-jp/      finance-portal-jp/      ops-portal-jp/    documents/      m1_reference.xlsx  chrome-profiles/          <- gitignored; Chrome user-data-dirs with extension    m1-hr/    m1-finance/    m1-ops/  gt-logs/                  <- gitignored; GT JSONL files and packages```---## 7. Troubleshooting| Symptom | Fix ||---|---|| `[warn] Extension not found` | Redo one-time extension setup (section 2). Check `chrome-profiles/m1-hr/Default/Secure Preferences` contains the extension ID. || `[warn] NMH not running` | Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent before launching. || `browser_navigation: 0` in chunk | Extension was loaded after portals were already open (content scripts didn't inject). Close Chrome, re-run — extension now loads at Chrome start. || Port 5122/5123/5124 already in use | Run `taskkill /F /IM python.exe` or restart. || `pyautogui` / `websocket` not found | `pip install pyautogui websocket-client` || GT log not found after run | Check `gt-logs/` in the theme_m1_data folder. Confirm the orchestrator didn't crash mid-run. |v介護休業申請を受理。期間: 2026-07-30 〜 2027-01-11。HW-2026-409と照合済。承認完了。----------------------------------------千葉金属工業へ PO-2026-469 に関する'数量変更依頼'を送付。回答待ち。----------------------------------------みずほ銀行 勘定照合 2026-05-W3。未達取引 TXN-490 を照合。仕訳 JV-20-330 で消込完了。----------------------------------------横浜精機へ PO-2026-544 に関する'納期回答依頼'を送付。回答待ち。----------------------------------------三井住友銀行 勘定照合 2026-05-W4。未達取引 TXN-843 を照合。仕訳 JV-37-265 で消込完了。

One-time browser extension setupThe ProcMine browser extension captures browser navigation, clicks, and form inputs (L3 events). It must be loaded into each of the three Chrome portal windows once. # Theme M1 — Local Setup GuideMixed multi-domain orchestrator (HR + Finance + Ops portals).  Produces aligned GT logs for UIA AutoSeg V2 evaluation.---## Prerequisites| Requirement | Notes ||---|---|| Python 3.11+ | Must be on PATH or at a standard install location || Google Chrome | Standard install at `C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\` || ProcMine Desktop Agent | Must be running and recording before you start a session || ProcMine Browser Extension | Unpacked extension folder (one-time Chrome setup below) || Microsoft Excel | Optional — lookup steps are skipped if absent |> Teams, Outlook, and OneNote are **not required**. The orchestrator skips those noise steps automatically if the apps are not present.---## 1. Clone and install dependencies```powershellgit clone https://github.com/I-mBesideYou/procmine-test-sets.gitcd procmine-test-sets/Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automationpip install pyautogui websocket-client```---## 2. One-time browser extension setupThe ProcMine browser extension captures browser navigation, clicks, and form inputs (L3 events). It must be loaded into each of the three Chrome portal windows once. After that it persists in the Chrome profiles stored at `theme_m1_data/chrome-profiles/` and loads automatically on every future run.**Step 1 — Get the extension**Download `procmine-extension-v1.0.0.zip` from the team drive and unzip it. Note the path to the unpacked folder (e.g. `C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension\`).**Step 2 — Run the one-time setup script**```powershellcd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation$chrome = "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"$base   = "$PSScriptRoot\..\..\chrome-profiles"   # created automatically$ext    = "C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension"  # your path# Kill any existing Chrome, then open one window per portaltaskkill /F /IM chrome.exe 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2foreach ($entry in @(    @{dir="m1-hr";      url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"},    @{dir="m1-finance"; url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"},    @{dir="m1-ops";     url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"})) {    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$base\$($entry.dir)" | Out-Null    Start-Process $chrome -ArgumentList "--user-data-dir=`"$base\$($entry.dir)`"","--no-first-run","--new-window",$entry.url    Start-Sleep 3}```> The portals won't load (no http.server running yet) — that's fine. You just need Chrome open with each profile.**Step 3 — Load the extension in each window**In each of the 3 Chrome windows:1. Open a new tab → navigate to `chrome://extensions`2. Enable **Developer mode** (toggle, top-right)3. Click **Load unpacked** → select the `procmine-extension` folder4. Confirm extension ID `gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn` appears5. Close the extensions tab**Step 4 — Close all Chrome windows**The extension is now saved to each profile. You're done — don't repeat this unless you delete `chrome-profiles/`.---## 3. Running a session**Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent first** and confirm it is recording.Then run either launcher:```powershell# PowerShell launcher (interactive prompts)cd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation.\launch_m1.ps1# Or Python launcher (same behaviour, cross-platform args)python scripts/run_theme_m1.pypython scripts/run_theme_m1.py --seed 42 --speed 1 --scale 2```### Run parameters| Prompt / Flag | Values | Default ||---|---|---|| Seed | Any integer | Random || Speed | `1` = fast (0.4×) · `2` = normal (1.4×) | `2` || Scale | `1` = 5–7 procs · `2` = 8–10 · `3` = 11–14 | `2` || Date | `YYYY-MM-DD` | Today |Pre-set with env vars to skip prompts:```powershell$env:M1_SEED = "42"; $env:M1_SPEED = "1"; $env:M1_SCALE = "2".\launch_m1.ps1```### What launches- 3 Python `http.server` instances (ports 5122 / 5123 / 5124)- Notepad- Excel with `documents/m1_reference.xlsx` (if available)- 3 Chrome windows (HR / Finance / Ops portals), each with CDP and ProcMine extension### Extension checkThe launcher prints one of:```[OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured``````[warn] Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: ...```If you see the warn, do the one-time extension setup (section 2) before continuing.---## 4. OutputAfter the run, GT logs land in:```Mixed/theme_m1_data/gt-logs/  theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl```Raw chunk arrives in S3 a few minutes after the session ends (desktop agent uploads asynchronously).---## 5. Per-chunk delivery packageOnce the chunk is in S3, generate the delivery package manually:```bashpython scripts/gen_chunk_package.py \  --gt    gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --out   gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_package \  --events   /path/to/downloaded/events.jsonl \  --manifest /path/to/downloaded/manifest.json \  --s3-prefix s3://procmine-app/chunks/<uid>/<chunk_id>/```Then run the official self-check:```bashpython C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py \  --events-jsonl /path/to/events.jsonl \  --manifest     /path/to/manifest.json \  --gt-jsonl     gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --no-run-pipeline --summary-only --pretty```Minimum pass criteria (from handoff doc section 4.4):```guardrails.status = pass (or warn)guardrails.failures = []manifest_event_line_count == actual event_count: OKGT/raw timestamp overlap: high (≥ 90%)```---## 6. Folder layout after setup```Mixed/theme_m1_data/  process_automation/       <- launchers and scripts    launch_m1.ps1    scripts/      orchestrator_m1.py      run_theme_m1.py      gen_chunk_package.py      uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py    tools/      hr-portal-jp/      finance-portal-jp/      ops-portal-jp/    documents/      m1_reference.xlsx  chrome-profiles/          <- gitignored; Chrome user-data-dirs with extension    m1-hr/    m1-finance/    m1-ops/  gt-logs/                  <- gitignored; GT JSONL files and packages```---## 7. Troubleshooting| Symptom | Fix ||---|---|| `[warn] Extension not found` | Redo one-time extension setup (section 2). Check `chrome-profiles/m1-hr/Default/Secure Preferences` contains the extension ID. || `[warn] NMH not running` | Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent before launching. || `browser_navigation: 0` in chunk | Extension was loaded after portals were already open (content scripts didn't inject). Close Chrome, re-run — extension now loads at Chrome start. || Port 5122/5123/5124 already in use | Run `taskkill /F /IM python.exe` or restart. || `pyautogui` / `websocket` not found | `pip install pyautogui websocket-client` || GT log not found after run | Check `gt-logs/` in the theme_m1_data folder. Confirm the orchestrator didn't crash mid-run. |v介護休業申請を受理。期間: 2026-07-30 〜 2027-01-11。HW-2026-409と照合済。承認完了。----------------------------------------千葉金属工業へ PO-2026-469 に関する'数量変更依頼'を送付。回答待ち。----------------------------------------みずほ銀行 勘定照合 2026-05-W3。未達取引 TXN-490 を照合。仕訳 JV-20-330 で消込完了。----------------------------------------横浜精機へ PO-2026-544 に関する'納期回答依頼'を送付。回答待ち。----------------------------------------三井住友銀行 勘定照合 2026-05-W4。未達取引 TXN-843 を照合。仕訳 JV-37-265 で消込完了。----------------------------------------住民税通知書を受領。特別徴収額 31,700円/月を確認。前年比適正範囲内。確認済とする。

One-time browser extension setupThe ProcMine browser extension captures browser navigation, clicks, and form inputs (L3 events). It must be loaded into each of the three Chrome portal windows once. After that it persists in the Chrome profiles stored at `theme_m1_data/chrome-profiles/` and loads automatically on every future run.**Step 1 — Get the extension**Download `procmine-extension-v1.0.0.zip` from the team drive and unzip it. Note the path to the unpacked folder (e.g. `C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension\`).**Step 2 — Run the one-time setup script**```powershellcd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation$chrome = "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"$base   = "$PSScriptRoot\..\..\chrome-profiles"   # created automatically$ext    = "C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension"  # your path# Kill any existing Chrome, then open one window per portaltaskkill /F /IM chrome.exe 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2foreach ($entry in @(    @{dir="m1-hr";      url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"},    @{dir="m1-finance"; url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"},    @{dir="m1-ops";     url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"})) {    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$base\$($entry.dir)" | Out-Null    Start-Process $chrome -ArgumentList "--user-data-dir=`"$base\$($entry.dir)`"","--no-first-run","--new-window",$entry.url    Start-Sleep 3}```> The portals won't load (no http.server running yet) — that's fine. You just need Chrome open with each profile.**Step 3 — Load the extension in each window**In each of the 3 Chrome windows:1. Open a new tab → navigate to `chrome://extensions`2. Enable **Developer mode** (toggle, top-right)3. Click **Load unpacked** → select the `procmine-extension` folder4. Confirm extension ID `gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn` appears5. Close the extensions tab**Step 4 — Close all Chrome windows**The extension is now saved to each profile. You're done — don't repeat this unless you delete `chrome-profiles/`.---## 3. Running a session**Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent first** and confirm it is recording.Then run either launcher:```powershell# PowerShell launcher (interactive prompts)cd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation.\launch_m1.ps1# Or Python launcher (same behaviour, cross-platform args)python scripts/run_theme_m1.pypython scripts/run_theme_m1.py --seed 42 --speed 1 --scale 2```### Run parameters| Prompt / Flag | Values | Default ||---|---|---|| Seed | Any integer | Random || Speed | `1` = fast (0.4×) · `2` = normal (1.4×) | `2` || Scale | `1` = 5–7 procs · `2` = 8–10 · `3` = 11–14 | `2` || Date | `YYYY-MM-DD` | Today |Pre-set with env vars to skip prompts:```powershell$env:M1_SEED = "42"; $env:M1_SPEED = "1"; $env:M1_SCALE = "2".\launch_m1.ps1```### What launches- 3 Python `http.server` instances (ports 5122 / 5123 / 5124)- Notepad- Excel with `documents/m1_reference.xlsx` (if available)- 3 Chrome windows (HR / Finance / Ops portals), each with CDP and ProcMine extension### Extension checkThe launcher prints one of:```[OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured``````[warn] Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: ...```If you see the warn, do the one-time extension setup (section 2) before continuing.---## 4. OutputAfter the run, GT logs land in:```Mixed/theme_m1_data/gt-logs/  theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl```Raw chunk arrives in S3 a few minutes after the session ends (desktop agent uploads asynchronously).---## 5. One-time browser extension setupThe ProcMine browser extension captures browser navigation, clicks, and form inputs (L3 events). It must be loaded into each of the three Chrome portal windows once. After that it persists in the Chrome profiles stored at `theme_m1_data/chrome-profiles/` and loads automatically on every future run.**Step 1 — Get the extension**Download `procmine-extension-v1.0.0.zip` from the team drive and unzip it. Note the path to the unpacked folder (e.g. `C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension\`).**Step 2 — Run the one-time setup script**```powershellcd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation$chrome = "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"$base   = "$PSScriptRoot\..\..\chrome-profiles"   # created automatically$ext    = "C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension"  # your path# Kill any existing Chrome, then open one window per portaltaskkill /F /IM chrome.exe 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2foreach ($entry in @(    @{dir="m1-hr";      url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"},    @{dir="m1-finance"; url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"},    @{dir="m1-ops";     url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"})) {    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$base\$($entry.dir)" | Out-Null    Start-Process $chrome -ArgumentList "--user-data-dir=`"$base\$($entry.dir)`"","--no-first-run","--new-window",$entry.url    Start-Sleep 3}```> The portals won't load (no http.server running yet) — that's fine. Close the extensions tab**Step 4 — Close all Chrome windows**The extension is now saved to each profile. You're done — don't repeat this unless you delete `chrome-profiles/`.---## 3. Running a session**Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent first** and confirm it is recording.Then run either launcher:```powershell# PowerShell launcher (interactive prompts)cd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation.\launch_m1.ps1# Or Python launcher (same behaviour, cross-platform args)python scripts/run_theme_m1.pypython scripts/run_theme_m1.py --seed 42 --speed 1 --scale 2```### Run parameters| Prompt / Flag | Values | Default ||---|---|---|| Seed | Any integer | Random || Speed | `1` = fast (0.4×) · `2` = normal (1.4×) | `2` || Scale | `1` = 5–7 procs · `2` = 8–10 · `3` = 11–14 | `2` || Date | `YYYY-MM-DD` | Today |Pre-set with env vars to skip prompts:```powershell$env:M1_SEED = "42"; $env:M1_SPEED = "1"; $env:M1_SCALE = "2".\launch_m1.ps1```### What launches- 3 Python `http.server` instances (ports 5122 / 5123 / 5124)- Notepad- Excel with `documents/m1_reference.xlsx` (if available)- 3 Chrome windows (HR / Finance / Ops portals), each with CDP and ProcMine extension### Extension checkThe launcher prints one of:```[OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured``````[warn] Extension not found in profiles. # Theme M1 — Local Setup GuideMixed multi-domain orchestrator (HR + Finance + Ops portals).  Produces aligned GT logs for UIA AutoSeg V2 evaluation.---## Prerequisites| Requirement | Notes ||---|---|| Python 3.11+ | Must be on PATH or at a standard install location || Google Chrome | Standard install at `C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\` || ProcMine Desktop Agent | Must be running and recording before you start a session || ProcMine Browser Extension | Unpacked extension folder (one-time Chrome setup below) || Microsoft Excel | Optional — lookup steps are skipped if absent |> Teams, Outlook, and OneNote are **not required**. The orchestrator skips those noise steps automatically if the apps are not present.---## 1. Clone and install dependencies```powershellgit clone https://github.com/I-mBesideYou/procmine-test-sets.gitcd procmine-test-sets/Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automationpip install pyautogui websocket-client```---## 2. One-time browser extension setupThe ProcMine browser extension captures browser navigation, clicks, and form inputs (L3 events). It must be loaded into each of the three Chrome portal windows once. After that it persists in the Chrome profiles stored at `theme_m1_data/chrome-profiles/` and loads automatically on every future run.**Step 1 — Get the extension**Download `procmine-extension-v1.0.0.zip` from the team drive and unzip it. Note the path to the unpacked folder (e.g. `C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension\`).**Step 2 — Run the one-time setup script**```powershellcd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation$chrome = "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"$base   = "$PSScriptRoot\..\..\chrome-profiles"   # created automatically$ext    = "C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension"  # your path# Kill any existing Chrome, then open one window per portaltaskkill /F /IM chrome.exe 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2foreach ($entry in @(    @{dir="m1-hr";      url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"},    @{dir="m1-finance"; url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"},    @{dir="m1-ops";     url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"})) {    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$base\$($entry.dir)" | Out-Null    Start-Process $chrome -ArgumentList "--user-data-dir=`"$base\$($entry.dir)`"","--no-first-run","--new-window",$entry.url    Start-Sleep 3}```> The portals won't load (no http.server running yet) — that's fine. You just need Chrome open with each profile.**Step 3 — Load the extension in each window**In each of the 3 Chrome windows:1. Open a new tab → navigate to `chrome://extensions`2. Enable **Developer mode** (toggle, top-right)3. Click **Load unpacked** → select the `procmine-extension` folder4. Confirm extension ID `gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn` appears5. Close the extensions tab**Step 4 — Close all Chrome windows**The extension is now saved to each profile. You're done — don't repeat this unless you delete `chrome-profiles/`.---## 3. Running a session**Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent first** and confirm it is recording.Then run either launcher:```powershell# PowerShell launcher (interactive prompts)cd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation.\launch_m1.ps1# Or Python launcher (same behaviour, cross-platform args)python scripts/run_theme_m1.pypython scripts/run_theme_m1.py --seed 42 --speed 1 --scale 2```### Run parameters| Prompt / Flag | Values | Default ||---|---|---|| Seed | Any integer | Random || Speed | `1` = fast (0.4×) · `2` = normal (1.4×) | `2` || Scale | `1` = 5–7 procs · `2` = 8–10 · `3` = 11–14 | `2` || Date | `YYYY-MM-DD` | Today |Pre-set with env vars to skip prompts:```powershell$env:M1_SEED = "42"; $env:M1_SPEED = "1"; $env:M1_SCALE = "2".\launch_m1.ps1```### What launches- 3 Python `http.server` instances (ports 5122 / 5123 / 5124)- Notepad- Excel with `documents/m1_reference.xlsx` (if available)- 3 Chrome windows (HR / Finance / Ops portals), each with CDP and ProcMine extension### Extension checkThe launcher prints one of:```[OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured``````[warn] Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: ...```If you see the warn, do the one-time extension setup (section 2) before continuing.---## 4. OutputAfter the run, GT logs land in:```Mixed/theme_m1_data/gt-logs/  theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl```Raw chunk arrives in S3 a few minutes after the session ends (desktop agent uploads asynchronously).---## 5. Per-chunk delivery packageOnce the chunk is in S3, generate the delivery package manually:```bashpython scripts/gen_chunk_package.py \  --gt    gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --out   gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_package \  --events   /path/to/downloaded/events.jsonl \  --manifest /path/to/downloaded/manifest.json \  --s3-prefix s3://procmine-app/chunks/<uid>/<chunk_id>/```Then run the official self-check:```bashpython C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py \  --events-jsonl /path/to/events.jsonl \  --manifest     /path/to/manifest.json \  --gt-jsonl     gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --no-run-pipeline --summary-only --pretty```Minimum pass criteria (from handoff doc section 4.4):```guardrails.status = pass (or warn)guardrails.failures = []manifest_event_line_count == actual event_count: OKGT/raw timestamp overlap: high (≥ 90%)```---## 6. Folder layout after setup```Mixed/theme_m1_data/  process_automation/       <- launchers and scripts    launch_m1.ps1    scripts/      orchestrator_m1.py      run_theme_m1.py      gen_chunk_package.py      uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py    tools/      hr-portal-jp/      finance-portal-jp/      ops-portal-jp/    documents/      m1_reference.xlsx  chrome-profiles/          <- gitignored; Chrome user-data-dirs with extension    m1-hr/    m1-finance/    m1-ops/  gt-logs/                  <- gitignored; GT JSONL files and packages```---## 7. Troubleshooting| Symptom | Fix ||---|---|| `[warn] Extension not found` | Redo one-time extension setup (section 2). Check `chrome-profiles/m1-hr/Default/Secure Preferences` contains the extension ID. || `[warn] NMH not running` | Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent before launching. || `browser_navigation: 0` in chunk | Extension was loaded after portals were already open (content scripts didn't inject). Close Chrome, re-run — extension now loads at Chrome start. || Port 5122/5123/5124 already in use | Run `taskkill /F /IM python.exe` or restart. || `pyautogui` / `websocket` not found | `pip install pyautogui websocket-client` || GT log not found after run | Check `gt-logs/` in the theme_m1_data folder. Confirm the orchestrator didn't crash mid-run. |v介護休業申請を受理。期間: 2026-07-30 〜 2027-01-11。HW-2026-409と照合済。承認完了。----------------------------------------千葉金属工業へ PO-2026-469 に関する'数量変更依頼'を送付。回答待ち。----------------------------------------みずほ銀行 勘定照合 2026-05-W3。未達取引 TXN-490 を照合。仕訳 JV-20-330 で消込完了。----------------------------------------横浜精機へ PO-2026-544 に関する'納期回答依頼'を送付。回答待ち。----------------------------------------三井住友銀行 勘定照合 2026-05-W4。未達取引 TXN-843 を照合。仕訳 JV-37-265 で消込完了。----------------------------------------住民税通知書を受領。特別徴収額 31,700円/月を確認。前年比適正範囲内。確認済とする。----------------------------------------前年比 +7,400円の乖離を検知。東京都渋谷区へ確認票を送付し再計算を依頼する。担当：吉田 恵子。

target_field.value: # Theme M1 — Local Setup GuideMixed multi-domain orchestrator (HR + Finance + Ops portals).  Produces aligned GT logs for UIA AutoSeg V2 evaluation.---## Prerequisites| Requirement | Notes ||---|---|| Python 3.11+ | Must be on PATH or at a standard install location || Google Chrome | Standard install at `C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\` || ProcMine Desktop Agent | Must be running and recording before you start a session || ProcMine Browser Extension | Unpacked extension folder (one-time Chrome setup below) || Microsoft Excel | Optional — lookup steps are skipped if absent |> Teams, Outlook, and OneNote are **not required**. The orchestrator skips those noise steps automatically if the apps are not present.---## 1. Clone and install dependencies```powershellgit clone https://github.com/I-mBesideYou/procmine-test-sets.gitcd procmine-test-sets/Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automationpip install pyautogui websocket-client```---## 2. One-time browser extension setupThe ProcMine browser extension captures browser navigation, clicks, and form inputs (L3 events). It must be loaded into each of the three Chrome portal windows once. After that it persists in the Chrome profiles stored at `theme_m1_data/chrome-profiles/` and loads automatically on every future run.**Step 1 — Get the extension**Download `procmine-extension-v1.0.0.zip` from the team drive and unzip it. Note the path to the unpacked folder (e.g. `C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension\`).**Step 2 — Run the one-time setup script**```powershellcd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation$chrome = "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"$base   = "$PSScriptRoot\..\..\chrome-profiles"   # created automatically$ext    = "C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension"  # your path# Kill any existing Chrome, then open one window per portaltaskkill /F /IM chrome.exe 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2foreach ($entry in @(    @{dir="m1-hr";      url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"},    @{dir="m1-finance"; url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"},    @{dir="m1-ops";     url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"})) {    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$base\$($entry.dir)" | Out-Null    Start-Process $chrome -ArgumentList "--user-data-dir=`"$base\$($entry.dir)`"","--no-first-run","--new-window",$entry.url    Start-Sleep 3}```> The portals won't load (no http.server running yet) — that's fine. You just need Chrome open with each profile.**Step 3 — Load the extension in each window**In each of the 3 Chrome windows:1. Open a new tab → navigate to `chrome://extensions`2. Enable **Developer mode** (toggle, top-right)3. Click **Load unpacked** → select the `procmine-extension` folder4. Confirm extension ID `gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn` appears5. Close the extensions tab**Step 4 — Close all Chrome windows**The extension is now saved to each profile. You're done — don't repeat this unless you delete `chrome-profiles/`.---## 3. Running a session**Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent first** and confirm it is recording.Then run either launcher:```powershell# PowerShell launcher (interactive prompts)cd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation.\launch_m1.ps1# Or Python launcher (same behaviour, cross-platform args)python scripts/run_theme_m1.pypython scripts/run_theme_m1.py --seed 42 --speed 1 --scale 2```### Run parameters| Prompt / Flag | Values | Default ||---|---|---|| Seed | Any integer | Random || Speed | `1` = fast (0.4×) · `2` = normal (1.4×) | `2` || Scale | `1` = 5–7 procs · `2` = 8–10 · `3` = 11–14 | `2` || Date | `YYYY-MM-DD` | Today |Pre-set with env vars to skip prompts:```powershell$env:M1_SEED = "42"; $env:M1_SPEED = "1"; $env:M1_SCALE = "2".\launch_m1.ps1```### What launches- 3 Python `http.server` instances (ports 5122 / 5123 / 5124)- Notepad- Excel with `documents/m1_reference.xlsx` (if available)- 3 Chrome windows (HR / Finance / Ops portals), each with CDP and ProcMine extension### Extension checkThe launcher prints one of:```[OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured``````[warn] Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: ...```If you see the warn, do the one-time extension setup (section 2) before continuing.---## 4. OutputAfter the run, GT logs land in:```Mixed/theme_m1_data/gt-logs/  theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl```Raw chunk arrives in S3 a few minutes after the session ends (desktop agent uploads asynchronously).---## 5. Per-chunk delivery packageOnce the chunk is in S3, generate the delivery package manually:```bashpython scripts/gen_chunk_package.py \  --gt    gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --out   gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_package \  --events   /path/to/downloaded/events.jsonl \  --manifest /path/to/downloaded/manifest.json \  --s3-prefix s3://procmine-app/chunks/<uid>/<chunk_id>/```Then run the official self-check:```bashpython C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py \  --events-jsonl /path/to/events.jsonl \  --manifest     /path/to/manifest.json \  --gt-jsonl     gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --no-run-pipeline --summary-only --pretty```Minimum pass criteria (from handoff doc section 4.4):```guardrails.status = pass (or warn)guardrails.failures = []manifest_event_line_count == actual event_count: OKGT/raw timestamp overlap: high (≥ 90%)```---## 6. Folder layout after setup```Mixed/theme_m1_data/  process_automation/       <- launchers and scripts    launch_m1.ps1    scripts/      orchestrator_m1.py      run_theme_m1.py      gen_chunk_package.py      uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py    tools/      hr-portal-jp/      finance-portal-jp/      ops-portal-jp/    documents/      m1_reference.xlsx  chrome-profiles/          <- gitignored; Chrome user-data-dirs with extension    m1-hr/    m1-finance/    m1-ops/  gt-logs/                  <- gitignored; GT JSONL files and packages```---## 7. Troubleshooting| Symptom | Fix ||---|---|| `[warn] Extension not found` | Redo one-time extension setup (section 2). Check `chrome-profiles/m1-hr/Default/Secure Preferences` contains the extension ID. || `[warn] NMH not running` | Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent before launching. || `browser_navigation: 0` in chunk | Extension was loaded after portals were already open (content scripts didn't inject). Close Chrome, re-run — extension now loads at Chrome start. || Port 5122/5123/5124 already in use | Run `taskkill /F /IM python.exe` or restart. || `pyautogui` / `websocket` not found | `pip install pyautogui websocket-client` || GT log not found after run | Check `gt-logs/` in the theme_m1_data folder. Confirm the orchestrator didn't crash mid-run. |v介護休業申請を受理。期間: 2026-07-30 〜 2027-01-11。HW-2026-409と照合済。承認完了。----------------------------------------千葉金属工業へ PO-2026-469 に関する'数量変更依頼'を送付。回答待ち。----------------------------------------みずほ銀行 勘定照合 2026-05-W3。未達取引 TXN-490 を照合。仕訳 JV-20-330 で消込完了。----------------------------------------横浜精機へ PO-2026-544 に関する'納期回答依頼'を送付。回答待ち。----------------------------------------三井住友銀行 勘定照合 2026-05-W4。未達取引 TXN-843 を照合。仕訳 JV-37-265 で消込完了。----------------------------------------住民税通知書を受領。特別徴収額 31,700円/月を確認。前年比適正範囲内。確認済とする。----------------------------------------前年比 +7,400円の乖離を検知。東京都渋谷区へ確認票を送付し再計算を依頼する。担当：吉田 恵子。

# Theme M1 — Local Setup GuideMixed multi-domain orchestrator (HR + Finance + Ops portals).  Produces aligned GT logs for UIA AutoSeg V2 evaluation.---## Prerequisites| Requirement | Notes ||---|---|| Python 3.11+ | Must be on PATH or at a standard install location || Google Chrome | Standard install at `C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\` || ProcMine Desktop Agent | Must be running and recording before you start a session || ProcMine Browser Extension | Unpacked extension folder (one-time Chrome setup below) || Microsoft Excel | Optional — lookup steps are skipped if absent |> Teams, Outlook, and OneNote are **not required**. The orchestrator skips those noise steps automatically if the apps are not present.---## 1. Clone and install dependencies```powershellgit clone https://github.com/I-mBesideYou/procmine-test-sets.gitcd procmine-test-sets/Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automationpip install pyautogui websocket-client```---## 2. One-time browser extension setupThe ProcMine browser extension captures browser navigation, clicks, and form inputs (L3 events). It must be loaded into each of the three Chrome portal windows once. After that it persists in the Chrome profiles stored at `theme_m1_data/chrome-profiles/` and loads automatically on every future run.**Step 1 — Get the extension**Download `procmine-extension-v1.0.0.zip` from the team drive and unzip it. Note the path to the unpacked folder (e.g. `C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension\`).**Step 2 — Run the one-time setup script**```powershellcd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation$chrome = "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"$base   = "$PSScriptRoot\..\..\chrome-profiles"   # created automatically$ext    = "C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension"  # your path# Kill any existing Chrome, then open one window per portaltaskkill /F /IM chrome.exe 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2foreach ($entry in @(    @{dir="m1-hr";      url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"},    @{dir="m1-finance"; url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"},    @{dir="m1-ops";     url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"})) {    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$base\$($entry.dir)" | Out-Null    Start-Process $chrome -ArgumentList "--user-data-dir=`"$base\$($entry.dir)`"","--no-first-run","--new-window",$entry.url    Start-Sleep 3}```> The portals won't load (no http.server running yet) — that's fine. You just need Chrome open with each profile.**Step 3 — Load the extension in each window**In each of the 3 Chrome windows:1. Open a new tab → navigate to `chrome://extensions`2. Enable **Developer mode** (toggle, top-right)3. Click **Load unpacked** → select the `procmine-extension` folder4. Confirm extension ID `gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn` appears5. Close the extensions tab**Step 4 — Close all Chrome windows**The extension is now saved to each profile. You're done — don't repeat this unless you delete `chrome-profiles/`.---## 3. Running a session**Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent first** and confirm it is recording.Then run either launcher:```powershell# PowerShell launcher (interactive prompts)cd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation.\launch_m1.ps1# Or Python launcher (same behaviour, cross-platform args)python scripts/run_theme_m1.pypython scripts/run_theme_m1.py --seed 42 --speed 1 --scale 2```### Run parameters| Prompt / Flag | Values | Default ||---|---|---|| Seed | Any integer | Random || Speed | `1` = fast (0.4×) · `2` = normal (1.4×) | `2` || Scale | `1` = 5–7 procs · `2` = 8–10 · `3` = 11–14 | `2` || Date | `YYYY-MM-DD` | Today |Pre-set with env vars to skip prompts:```powershell$env:M1_SEED = "42"; $env:M1_SPEED = "1"; $env:M1_SCALE = "2".\launch_m1.ps1```### What launches- 3 Python `http.server` instances (ports 5122 / 5123 / 5124)- Notepad- Excel with `documents/m1_reference.xlsx` (if available)- 3 Chrome windows (HR / Finance / Ops portals), each with CDP and ProcMine extension### Extension checkThe launcher prints one of:```[OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured``````[warn] Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: ...```If you see the warn, do the one-time extension setup (section 2) before continuing.---## 4. OutputAfter the run, GT logs land in:```Mixed/theme_m1_data/gt-logs/  theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl```Raw chunk arrives in S3 a few minutes after the session ends (desktop agent uploads asynchronously).---## 5. Per-chunk delivery packageOnce the chunk is in S3, generate the delivery package manually:```bashpython scripts/gen_chunk_package.py \  --gt    gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --out   gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_package \  --events   /path/to/downloaded/events.jsonl \  --manifest /path/to/downloaded/manifest.json \  --s3-prefix s3://procmine-app/chunks/<uid>/<chunk_id>/```Then run the official self-check:```bashpython C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py \  --events-jsonl /path/to/events.jsonl \  --manifest     /path/to/manifest.json \  --gt-jsonl     gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --no-run-pipeline --summary-only --pretty```Minimum pass criteria (from handoff doc section 4.4):```guardrails.status = pass (or warn)guardrails.failures = []manifest_event_line_count == actual event_count: OKGT/raw timestamp overlap: high (≥ 90%)```---## 6. Folder layout after setup```Mixed/theme_m1_data/  process_automation/       <- launchers and scripts    launch_m1.ps1    scripts/      orchestrator_m1.py      run_theme_m1.py      gen_chunk_package.py      uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py    tools/      hr-portal-jp/      finance-portal-jp/      ops-portal-jp/    documents/      m1_reference.xlsx  chrome-profiles/          <- gitignored; Chrome user-data-dirs with extension    m1-hr/    m1-finance/    m1-ops/  gt-logs/                  <- gitignored; GT JSONL files and packages```---## 7. Troubleshooting| Symptom | Fix ||---|---|| `[warn] Extension not found` | Redo one-time extension setup (section 2). Check `chrome-profiles/m1-hr/Default/Secure Preferences` contains the extension ID. || `[warn] NMH not running` | Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent before launching. || `browser_navigation: 0` in chunk | Extension was loaded after portals were already open (content scripts didn't inject). Close Chrome, re-run — extension now loads at Chrome start. || Port 5122/5123/5124 already in use | Run `taskkill /F /IM python.exe` or restart. || `pyautogui` / `websocket` not found | `pip install pyautogui websocket-client` || GT log not found after run | Check `gt-logs/` in the theme_m1_data folder. Confirm the orchestrator didn't crash mid-run. |v介護休業申請を受理。期間: 2026-07-30 〜 2027-01-11。HW-2026-409と照合済。承認完了。----------------------------------------千葉金属工業へ PO-2026-469 に関する'数量変更依頼'を送付。回答待ち。----------------------------------------みずほ銀行 勘定照合 2026-05-W3。未達取引 TXN-490 を照合。仕訳 JV-20-330 で消込完了。----------------------------------------横浜精機へ PO-2026-544 に関する'納期回答依頼'を送付。回答待ち。----------------------------------------三井住友銀行 勘定照合 2026-05-W4。未達取引 TXN-843 を照合。仕訳 JV-37-265 で消込完了。----------------------------------------住民税通知書を受領。特別徴収額 31,700円/月を確認。前年比適正範囲内。確認済とする。----------------------------------------前年比 +7,400円の乖離を検知。東京都渋谷区へ確認票を送付し再計算を依頼する。担当：吉田 恵子。----------------------------------------北陸金属へ PO-2026-484 に関する'品質証明書督促'を送付。回答待ち。

You just need Chrome open with each profile.**Step 3 — Load the extension in each window**In each of the 3 Chrome windows:1. Open a new tab → navigate to `chrome://extensions`2. Enable **Developer mode** (toggle, top-right)3. Click **Load unpacked** → select the `procmine-extension` folder4. Confirm extension ID `gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn` appears5. Close the extensions tab**Step 4 — Close all Chrome windows**The extension is now saved to each profile. You're done — don't repeat this unless you delete `chrome-profiles/`.---## 3. extracted_text.text: # Theme M1 — Local Setup GuideMixed multi-domain orchestrator (HR + Finance + Ops portals).  Produces aligned GT logs for UIA AutoSeg V2 evaluation.---## Prerequisites| Requirement | Notes ||---|---|| Python 3.11+ | Must be on PATH or at a standard install location || Google Chrome | Standard install at `C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\` || ProcMine Desktop Agent | Must be running and recording before you start a session || ProcMine Browser Extension | Unpacked extension folder (one-time Chrome setup below) || Microsoft Excel | Optional — lookup steps are skipped if absent |> Teams, Outlook, and OneNote are **not required**. The orchestrator skips those noise steps automatically if the apps are not present.---## 1. Clone and install dependencies```powershellgit clone https://github.com/I-mBesideYou/procmine-test-sets.gitcd procmine-test-sets/Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automationpip install pyautogui websocket-client```---## 2. One-time browser extension setupThe ProcMine browser extension captures browser navigation, clicks, and form inputs (L3 events). It must be loaded into each of the three Chrome portal windows once. After that it persists in the Chrome profiles stored at `theme_m1_data/chrome-profiles/` and loads automatically on every future run.**Step 1 — Get the extension**Download `procmine-extension-v1.0.0.zip` from the team drive and unzip it. Note the path to the unpacked folder (e.g. `C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension\`).**Step 2 — Run the one-time setup script**```powershellcd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation$chrome = "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"$base   = "$PSScriptRoot\..\..\chrome-profiles"   # created automatically$ext    = "C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension"  # your path# Kill any existing Chrome, then open one window per portaltaskkill /F /IM chrome.exe 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2foreach ($entry in @(    @{dir="m1-hr";      url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"},    @{dir="m1-finance"; url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"},    @{dir="m1-ops";     url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"})) {    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$base\$($entry.dir)" | Out-Null    Start-Process $chrome -ArgumentList "--user-data-dir=`"$base\$($entry.dir)`"","--no-first-run","--new-window",$entry.url    Start-Sleep 3}```> The portals won't load (no http.server running yet) — that's fine. You just need Chrome open with each profile.**Step 3 — Load the extension in each window**In each of the 3 Chrome windows:1. Open a new tab → navigate to `chrome://extensions`2. Enable **Developer mode** (toggle, top-right)3. Click **Load unpacked** → select the `procmine-extension` folder4. Confirm extension ID `gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn` appears5. Close the extensions tab**Step 4 — Close all Chrome windows**The extension is now saved to each profile. You're done — don't repeat this unless you delete `chrome-profiles/`.---## 3. Running a session**Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent first** and confirm it is recording.Then run either launcher:```powershell# PowerShell launcher (interactive prompts)cd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation.\launch_m1.ps1# Or Python launcher (same behaviour, cross-platform args)python scripts/run_theme_m1.pypython scripts/run_theme_m1.py --seed 42 --speed 1 --scale 2```### Run parameters| Prompt / Flag | Values | Default ||---|---|---|| Seed | Any integer | Random || Speed | `1` = fast (0.4×) · `2` = normal (1.4×) | `2` || Scale | `1` = 5–7 procs · `2` = 8–10 · `3` = 11–14 | `2` || Date | `YYYY-MM-DD` | Today |Pre-set with env vars to skip prompts:```powershell$env:M1_SEED = "42"; $env:M1_SPEED = "1"; $env:M1_SCALE = "2".\launch_m1.ps1```### What launches- 3 Python `http.server` instances (ports 5122 / 5123 / 5124)- Notepad- Excel with `documents/m1_reference.xlsx` (if available)- 3 Chrome windows (HR / Finance / Ops portals), each with CDP and ProcMine extension### Extension checkThe launcher prints one of:```[OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured``````[warn] Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: ...```If you see the warn, do the one-time extension setup (section 2) before continuing.---## 4. OutputAfter the run, GT logs land in:```Mixed/theme_m1_data/gt-logs/  theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl```Raw chunk arrives in S3 a few minutes after the session ends (desktop agent uploads asynchronously).---## 5. Per-chunk delivery packageOnce the chunk is in S3, generate the delivery package manually:```bashpython scripts/gen_chunk_package.py \  --gt    gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --out   gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_package \  --events   /path/to/downloaded/events.jsonl \  --manifest /path/to/downloaded/manifest.json \  --s3-prefix s3://procmine-app/chunks/<uid>/<chunk_id>/```Then run the official self-check:```bashpython C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py \  --events-jsonl /path/to/events.jsonl \  --manifest     /path/to/manifest.json \  --gt-jsonl     gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --no-run-pipeline --summary-only --pretty```Minimum pass criteria (from handoff doc section 4.4):```guardrails.status = pass (or warn)guardrails.failures = []manifest_event_line_count == actual event_count: OKGT/raw timestamp overlap: high (≥ 90%)```---## 6. Folder layout after setup```Mixed/theme_m1_data/  process_automation/       <- launchers and scripts    launch_m1.ps1    scripts/      orchestrator_m1.py      run_theme_m1.py      gen_chunk_package.py      uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py    tools/      hr-portal-jp/      finance-portal-jp/      ops-portal-jp/    documents/      m1_reference.xlsx  chrome-profiles/          <- gitignored; Chrome user-data-dirs with extension    m1-hr/    m1-finance/    m1-ops/  gt-logs/                  <- gitignored; GT JSONL files and packages```---## 7. Troubleshooting| Symptom | Fix ||---|---|| `[warn] Extension not found` | Redo one-time extension setup (section 2). Check `chrome-profiles/m1-hr/Default/Secure Preferences` contains the extension ID. || `[warn] NMH not running` | Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent before launching. || `browser_navigation: 0` in chunk | Extension was loaded after portals were already open (content scripts didn't inject). Close Chrome, re-run — extension now loads at Chrome start. || Port 5122/5123/5124 already in use | Run `taskkill /F /IM python.exe` or restart. || `pyautogui` / `websocket` not found | `pip install pyautogui websocket-client` || GT log not found after run | Check `gt-logs/` in the theme_m1_data folder. Confirm the orchestrator didn't crash mid-run. |v介護休業申請を受理。期間: 2026-07-30 〜 2027-01-11。HW-2026-409と照合済。承認完了。----------------------------------------千葉金属工業へ PO-2026-469 に関する'数量変更依頼'を送付。回答待ち。----------------------------------------みずほ銀行 勘定照合 2026-05-W3。未達取引 TXN-490 を照合。仕訳 JV-20-330 で消込完了。----------------------------------------横浜精機へ PO-2026-544 に関する'納期回答依頼'を送付。回答待ち。----------------------------------------三井住友銀行 勘定照合 2026-05-W4。未達取引 TXN-843 を照合。仕訳 JV-37-265 で消込完了。----------------------------------------住民税通知書を受領。特別徴収額 31,700円/月を確認。前年比適正範囲内。確認済とする。----------------------------------------前年比 +7,400円の乖離を検知。東京都渋谷区へ確認票を送付し再計算を依頼する。担当：吉田 恵子。----------------------------------------北陸金属へ PO-2026-484 に関する'品質証明書督促'を送付。回答待ち。----------------------------------------オムロン株式会社 PM-175009-003 — 支払額 1,800,000円。支払期日 2026-07-11。保留事項あり。担当へ確認依頼。

target_field.value: # Theme M1 — Local Setup GuideMixed multi-domain orchestrator (HR + Finance + Ops portals).  Produces aligned GT logs for UIA AutoSeg V2 evaluation.---## Prerequisites| Requirement | Notes ||---|---|| Python 3.11+ | Must be on PATH or at a standard install location || Google Chrome | Standard install at `C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\` || ProcMine Desktop Agent | Must be running and recording before you start a session || ProcMine Browser Extension | Unpacked extension folder (one-time Chrome setup below) || Microsoft Excel | Optional — lookup steps are skipped if absent |> Teams, Outlook, and OneNote are **not required**. The orchestrator skips those noise steps automatically if the apps are not present.---## 1. Clone and install dependencies```powershellgit clone https://github.com/I-mBesideYou/procmine-test-sets.gitcd procmine-test-sets/Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automationpip install pyautogui websocket-client```---## 2. One-time browser extension setupThe ProcMine browser extension captures browser navigation, clicks, and form inputs (L3 events). It must be loaded into each of the three Chrome portal windows once. After that it persists in the Chrome profiles stored at `theme_m1_data/chrome-profiles/` and loads automatically on every future run.**Step 1 — Get the extension**Download `procmine-extension-v1.0.0.zip` from the team drive and unzip it. Note the path to the unpacked folder (e.g. `C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension\`).**Step 2 — Run the one-time setup script**```powershellcd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation$chrome = "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"$base   = "$PSScriptRoot\..\..\chrome-profiles"   # created automatically$ext    = "C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension"  # your path# Kill any existing Chrome, then open one window per portaltaskkill /F /IM chrome.exe 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2foreach ($entry in @(    @{dir="m1-hr";      url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"},    @{dir="m1-finance"; url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"},    @{dir="m1-ops";     url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"})) {    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$base\$($entry.dir)" | Out-Null    Start-Process $chrome -ArgumentList "--user-data-dir=`"$base\$($entry.dir)`"","--no-first-run","--new-window",$entry.url    Start-Sleep 3}```> The portals won't load (no http.server running yet) — that's fine. You just need Chrome open with each profile.**Step 3 — Load the extension in each window**In each of the 3 Chrome windows:1. Open a new tab → navigate to `chrome://extensions`2. Enable **Developer mode** (toggle, top-right)3. Click **Load unpacked** → select the `procmine-extension` folder4. Confirm extension ID `gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn` appears5. Close the extensions tab**Step 4 — Close all Chrome windows**The extension is now saved to each profile. You're done — don't repeat this unless you delete `chrome-profiles/`.---## 3. Running a session**Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent first** and confirm it is recording.Then run either launcher:```powershell# PowerShell launcher (interactive prompts)cd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation.\launch_m1.ps1# Or Python launcher (same behaviour, cross-platform args)python scripts/run_theme_m1.pypython scripts/run_theme_m1.py --seed 42 --speed 1 --scale 2```### Run parameters| Prompt / Flag | Values | Default ||---|---|---|| Seed | Any integer | Random || Speed | `1` = fast (0.4×) · `2` = normal (1.4×) | `2` || Scale | `1` = 5–7 procs · `2` = 8–10 · `3` = 11–14 | `2` || Date | `YYYY-MM-DD` | Today |Pre-set with env vars to skip prompts:```powershell$env:M1_SEED = "42"; $env:M1_SPEED = "1"; $env:M1_SCALE = "2".\launch_m1.ps1```### What launches- 3 Python `http.server` instances (ports 5122 / 5123 / 5124)- Notepad- Excel with `documents/m1_reference.xlsx` (if available)- 3 Chrome windows (HR / Finance / Ops portals), each with CDP and ProcMine extension### Extension checkThe launcher prints one of:```[OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured``````[warn] Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: ...```If you see the warn, do the one-time extension setup (section 2) before continuing.---## 4. OutputAfter the run, GT logs land in:```Mixed/theme_m1_data/gt-logs/  theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl```Raw chunk arrives in S3 a few minutes after the session ends (desktop agent uploads asynchronously).---## 5. Per-chunk delivery packageOnce the chunk is in S3, generate the delivery package manually:```bashpython scripts/gen_chunk_package.py \  --gt    gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --out   gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_package \  --events   /path/to/downloaded/events.jsonl \  --manifest /path/to/downloaded/manifest.json \  --s3-prefix s3://procmine-app/chunks/<uid>/<chunk_id>/```Then run the official self-check:```bashpython C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py \  --events-jsonl /path/to/events.jsonl \  --manifest     /path/to/manifest.json \  --gt-jsonl     gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --no-run-pipeline --summary-only --pretty```Minimum pass criteria (from handoff doc section 4.4):```guardrails.status = pass (or warn)guardrails.failures = []manifest_event_line_count == actual event_count: OKGT/raw timestamp overlap: high (≥ 90%)```---## 6. Folder layout after setup```Mixed/theme_m1_data/  process_automation/       <- launchers and scripts    launch_m1.ps1    scripts/      orchestrator_m1.py      run_theme_m1.py      gen_chunk_package.py      uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py    tools/      hr-portal-jp/      finance-portal-jp/      ops-portal-jp/    documents/      m1_reference.xlsx  chrome-profiles/          <- gitignored; Chrome user-data-dirs with extension    m1-hr/    m1-finance/    m1-ops/  gt-logs/                  <- gitignored; GT JSONL files and packages```---## 7. Troubleshooting| Symptom | Fix ||---|---|| `[warn] Extension not found` | Redo one-time extension setup (section 2). Check `chrome-profiles/m1-hr/Default/Secure Preferences` contains the extension ID. || `[warn] NMH not running` | Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent before launching. || `browser_navigation: 0` in chunk | Extension was loaded after portals were already open (content scripts didn't inject). Close Chrome, re-run — extension now loads at Chrome start. || Port 5122/5123/5124 already in use | Run `taskkill /F /IM python.exe` or restart. || `pyautogui` / `websocket` not found | `pip install pyautogui websocket-client` || GT log not found after run | Check `gt-logs/` in the theme_m1_data folder. Confirm the orchestrator didn't crash mid-run. |v介護休業申請を受理。期間: 2026-07-30 〜 2027-01-11。HW-2026-409と照合済。承認完了。----------------------------------------千葉金属工業へ PO-2026-469 に関する'数量変更依頼'を送付。回答待ち。----------------------------------------みずほ銀行 勘定照合 2026-05-W3。未達取引 TXN-490 を照合。仕訳 JV-20-330 で消込完了。----------------------------------------横浜精機へ PO-2026-544 に関する'納期回答依頼'を送付。回答待ち。----------------------------------------三井住友銀行 勘定照合 2026-05-W4。未達取引 TXN-843 を照合。仕訳 JV-37-265 で消込完了。----------------------------------------住民税通知書を受領。特別徴収額 31,700円/月を確認。前年比適正範囲内。確認済とする。----------------------------------------前年比 +7,400円の乖離を検知。東京都渋谷区へ確認票を送付し再計算を依頼する。担当：吉田 恵子。----------------------------------------北陸金属へ PO-2026-484 に関する'品質証明書督促'を送付。回答待ち。----------------------------------------オムロン株式会社 PM-175009-003 — 支払額 1,800,000円。支払期日 2026-07-11。保留事項あり。担当へ確認依頼。

Per-chunk delivery packageOnce the chunk is in S3, generate the delivery package manually:```bashpython scripts/gen_chunk_package.py \  --gt    gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --out   gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_package \  --events   /path/to/downloaded/events.jsonl \  --manifest /path/to/downloaded/manifest.json \  --s3-prefix s3://procmine-app/chunks/<uid>/<chunk_id>/```Then run the official self-check:```bashpython C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py \  --events-jsonl /path/to/events.jsonl \  --manifest     /path/to/manifest.json \  --gt-jsonl     gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --no-run-pipeline --summary-only --pretty```Minimum pass criteria (from handoff doc section 4.4):```guardrails.status = pass (or warn)guardrails.failures = []manifest_event_line_count == actual event_count: OKGT/raw timestamp overlap: high (≥ 90%)```---## 6. # Theme M1 — Local Setup GuideMixed multi-domain orchestrator (HR + Finance + Ops portals).  Produces aligned GT logs for UIA AutoSeg V2 evaluation.---## Prerequisites| Requirement | Notes ||---|---|| Python 3.11+ | Must be on PATH or at a standard install location || Google Chrome | Standard install at `C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\` || ProcMine Desktop Agent | Must be running and recording before you start a session || ProcMine Browser Extension | Unpacked extension folder (one-time Chrome setup below) || Microsoft Excel | Optional — lookup steps are skipped if absent |> Teams, Outlook, and OneNote are **not required**. The orchestrator skips those noise steps automatically if the apps are not present.---## 1. Clone and install dependencies```powershellgit clone https://github.com/I-mBesideYou/procmine-test-sets.gitcd procmine-test-sets/Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automationpip install pyautogui websocket-client```---## 2. One-time browser extension setupThe ProcMine browser extension captures browser navigation, clicks, and form inputs (L3 events). It must be loaded into each of the three Chrome portal windows once. After that it persists in the Chrome profiles stored at `theme_m1_data/chrome-profiles/` and loads automatically on every future run.**Step 1 — Get the extension**Download `procmine-extension-v1.0.0.zip` from the team drive and unzip it. Note the path to the unpacked folder (e.g. `C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension\`).**Step 2 — Run the one-time setup script**```powershellcd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation$chrome = "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"$base   = "$PSScriptRoot\..\..\chrome-profiles"   # created automatically$ext    = "C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension"  # your path# Kill any existing Chrome, then open one window per portaltaskkill /F /IM chrome.exe 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2foreach ($entry in @(    @{dir="m1-hr";      url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"},    @{dir="m1-finance"; url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"},    @{dir="m1-ops";     url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"})) {    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$base\$($entry.dir)" | Out-Null    Start-Process $chrome -ArgumentList "--user-data-dir=`"$base\$($entry.dir)`"","--no-first-run","--new-window",$entry.url    Start-Sleep 3}```> The portals won't load (no http.server running yet) — that's fine. You just need Chrome open with each profile.**Step 3 — Load the extension in each window**In each of the 3 Chrome windows:1. Open a new tab → navigate to `chrome://extensions`2. Enable **Developer mode** (toggle, top-right)3. Click **Load unpacked** → select the `procmine-extension` folder4. Confirm extension ID `gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn` appears5. Close the extensions tab**Step 4 — Close all Chrome windows**The extension is now saved to each profile. You're done — don't repeat this unless you delete `chrome-profiles/`.---## 3. Running a session**Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent first** and confirm it is recording.Then run either launcher:```powershell# PowerShell launcher (interactive prompts)cd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation.\launch_m1.ps1# Or Python launcher (same behaviour, cross-platform args)python scripts/run_theme_m1.pypython scripts/run_theme_m1.py --seed 42 --speed 1 --scale 2```### Run parameters| Prompt / Flag | Values | Default ||---|---|---|| Seed | Any integer | Random || Speed | `1` = fast (0.4×) · `2` = normal (1.4×) | `2` || Scale | `1` = 5–7 procs · `2` = 8–10 · `3` = 11–14 | `2` || Date | `YYYY-MM-DD` | Today |Pre-set with env vars to skip prompts:```powershell$env:M1_SEED = "42"; $env:M1_SPEED = "1"; $env:M1_SCALE = "2".\launch_m1.ps1```### What launches- 3 Python `http.server` instances (ports 5122 / 5123 / 5124)- Notepad- Excel with `documents/m1_reference.xlsx` (if available)- 3 Chrome windows (HR / Finance / Ops portals), each with CDP and ProcMine extension### Extension checkThe launcher prints one of:```[OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured``````[warn] Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: ...```If you see the warn, do the one-time extension setup (section 2) before continuing.---## 4. OutputAfter the run, GT logs land in:```Mixed/theme_m1_data/gt-logs/  theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl```Raw chunk arrives in S3 a few minutes after the session ends (desktop agent uploads asynchronously).---## 5. Per-chunk delivery packageOnce the chunk is in S3, generate the delivery package manually:```bashpython scripts/gen_chunk_package.py \  --gt    gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --out   gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_package \  --events   /path/to/downloaded/events.jsonl \  --manifest /path/to/downloaded/manifest.json \  --s3-prefix s3://procmine-app/chunks/<uid>/<chunk_id>/```Then run the official self-check:```bashpython C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py \  --events-jsonl /path/to/events.jsonl \  --manifest     /path/to/manifest.json \  --gt-jsonl     gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --no-run-pipeline --summary-only --pretty```Minimum pass criteria (from handoff doc section 4.4):```guardrails.status = pass (or warn)guardrails.failures = []manifest_event_line_count == actual event_count: OKGT/raw timestamp overlap: high (≥ 90%)```---## 6. Folder layout after setup```Mixed/theme_m1_data/  process_automation/       <- launchers and scripts    launch_m1.ps1    scripts/      orchestrator_m1.py      run_theme_m1.py      gen_chunk_package.py      uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py    tools/      hr-portal-jp/      finance-portal-jp/      ops-portal-jp/    documents/      m1_reference.xlsx  chrome-profiles/          <- gitignored; Chrome user-data-dirs with extension    m1-hr/    m1-finance/    m1-ops/  gt-logs/                  <- gitignored; GT JSONL files and packages```---## 7. Troubleshooting| Symptom | Fix ||---|---|| `[warn] Extension not found` | Redo one-time extension setup (section 2). Check `chrome-profiles/m1-hr/Default/Secure Preferences` contains the extension ID. || `[warn] NMH not running` | Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent before launching. || `browser_navigation: 0` in chunk | Extension was loaded after portals were already open (content scripts didn't inject). Close Chrome, re-run — extension now loads at Chrome start. || Port 5122/5123/5124 already in use | Run `taskkill /F /IM python.exe` or restart. || `pyautogui` / `websocket` not found | `pip install pyautogui websocket-client` || GT log not found after run | Check `gt-logs/` in the theme_m1_data folder. Confirm the orchestrator didn't crash mid-run. |v介護休業申請を受理。期間: 2026-07-30 〜 2027-01-11。HW-2026-409と照合済。承認完了。----------------------------------------千葉金属工業へ PO-2026-469 に関する'数量変更依頼'を送付。回答待ち。----------------------------------------みずほ銀行 勘定照合 2026-05-W3。未達取引 TXN-490 を照合。仕訳 JV-20-330 で消込完了。----------------------------------------横浜精機へ PO-2026-544 に関する'納期回答依頼'を送付。回答待ち。----------------------------------------三井住友銀行 勘定照合 2026-05-W4。未達取引 TXN-843 を照合。仕訳 JV-37-265 で消込完了。----------------------------------------住民税通知書を受領。特別徴収額 31,700円/月を確認。前年比適正範囲内。確認済とする。----------------------------------------前年比 +7,400円の乖離を検知。東京都渋谷区へ確認票を送付し再計算を依頼する。担当：吉田 恵子。----------------------------------------北陸金属へ PO-2026-484 に関する'品質証明書督促'を送付。回答待ち。----------------------------------------オムロン株式会社 PM-175009-003 — 支払額 1,800,000円。支払期日 2026-07-11。保留事項あり。担当へ確認依頼。----------------------------------------入社予定者 森田 彩香（E1595）の書類照合完了。通勤手当 21,000円/月を給与マスタに登録。開発部配属。

target_field.value: # Theme M1 — Local Setup GuideMixed multi-domain orchestrator (HR + Finance + Ops portals).  Produces aligned GT logs for UIA AutoSeg V2 evaluation.---## Prerequisites| Requirement | Notes ||---|---|| Python 3.11+ | Must be on PATH or at a standard install location || Google Chrome | Standard install at `C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\` || ProcMine Desktop Agent | Must be running and recording before you start a session || ProcMine Browser Extension | Unpacked extension folder (one-time Chrome setup below) || Microsoft Excel | Optional — lookup steps are skipped if absent |> Teams, Outlook, and OneNote are **not required**. The orchestrator skips those noise steps automatically if the apps are not present.---## 1. Clone and install dependencies```powershellgit clone https://github.com/I-mBesideYou/procmine-test-sets.gitcd procmine-test-sets/Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automationpip install pyautogui websocket-client```---## 2. One-time browser extension setupThe ProcMine browser extension captures browser navigation, clicks, and form inputs (L3 events). It must be loaded into each of the three Chrome portal windows once. After that it persists in the Chrome profiles stored at `theme_m1_data/chrome-profiles/` and loads automatically on every future run.**Step 1 — Get the extension**Download `procmine-extension-v1.0.0.zip` from the team drive and unzip it. Note the path to the unpacked folder (e.g. `C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension\`).**Step 2 — Run the one-time setup script**```powershellcd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation$chrome = "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"$base   = "$PSScriptRoot\..\..\chrome-profiles"   # created automatically$ext    = "C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension"  # your path# Kill any existing Chrome, then open one window per portaltaskkill /F /IM chrome.exe 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2foreach ($entry in @(    @{dir="m1-hr";      url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"},    @{dir="m1-finance"; url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"},    @{dir="m1-ops";     url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"})) {    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$base\$($entry.dir)" | Out-Null    Start-Process $chrome -ArgumentList "--user-data-dir=`"$base\$($entry.dir)`"","--no-first-run","--new-window",$entry.url    Start-Sleep 3}```> The portals won't load (no http.server running yet) — that's fine. You just need Chrome open with each profile.**Step 3 — Load the extension in each window**In each of the 3 Chrome windows:1. Open a new tab → navigate to `chrome://extensions`2. Enable **Developer mode** (toggle, top-right)3. Click **Load unpacked** → select the `procmine-extension` folder4. Confirm extension ID `gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn` appears5. Close the extensions tab**Step 4 — Close all Chrome windows**The extension is now saved to each profile. You're done — don't repeat this unless you delete `chrome-profiles/`.---## 3. Running a session**Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent first** and confirm it is recording.Then run either launcher:```powershell# PowerShell launcher (interactive prompts)cd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation.\launch_m1.ps1# Or Python launcher (same behaviour, cross-platform args)python scripts/run_theme_m1.pypython scripts/run_theme_m1.py --seed 42 --speed 1 --scale 2```### Run parameters| Prompt / Flag | Values | Default ||---|---|---|| Seed | Any integer | Random || Speed | `1` = fast (0.4×) · `2` = normal (1.4×) | `2` || Scale | `1` = 5–7 procs · `2` = 8–10 · `3` = 11–14 | `2` || Date | `YYYY-MM-DD` | Today |Pre-set with env vars to skip prompts:```powershell$env:M1_SEED = "42"; $env:M1_SPEED = "1"; $env:M1_SCALE = "2".\launch_m1.ps1```### What launches- 3 Python `http.server` instances (ports 5122 / 5123 / 5124)- Notepad- Excel with `documents/m1_reference.xlsx` (if available)- 3 Chrome windows (HR / Finance / Ops portals), each with CDP and ProcMine extension### Extension checkThe launcher prints one of:```[OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured``````[warn] Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: ...```If you see the warn, do the one-time extension setup (section 2) before continuing.---## 4. OutputAfter the run, GT logs land in:```Mixed/theme_m1_data/gt-logs/  theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl```Raw chunk arrives in S3 a few minutes after the session ends (desktop agent uploads asynchronously).---## 5. Per-chunk delivery packageOnce the chunk is in S3, generate the delivery package manually:```bashpython scripts/gen_chunk_package.py \  --gt    gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --out   gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_package \  --events   /path/to/downloaded/events.jsonl \  --manifest /path/to/downloaded/manifest.json \  --s3-prefix s3://procmine-app/chunks/<uid>/<chunk_id>/```Then run the official self-check:```bashpython C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py \  --events-jsonl /path/to/events.jsonl \  --manifest     /path/to/manifest.json \  --gt-jsonl     gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --no-run-pipeline --summary-only --pretty```Minimum pass criteria (from handoff doc section 4.4):```guardrails.status = pass (or warn)guardrails.failures = []manifest_event_line_count == actual event_count: OKGT/raw timestamp overlap: high (≥ 90%)```---## 6. Folder layout after setup```Mixed/theme_m1_data/  process_automation/       <- launchers and scripts    launch_m1.ps1    scripts/      orchestrator_m1.py      run_theme_m1.py      gen_chunk_package.py      uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py    tools/      hr-portal-jp/      finance-portal-jp/      ops-portal-jp/    documents/      m1_reference.xlsx  chrome-profiles/          <- gitignored; Chrome user-data-dirs with extension    m1-hr/    m1-finance/    m1-ops/  gt-logs/                  <- gitignored; GT JSONL files and packages```---## 7. Troubleshooting| Symptom | Fix ||---|---|| `[warn] Extension not found` | Redo one-time extension setup (section 2). Check `chrome-profiles/m1-hr/Default/Secure Preferences` contains the extension ID. || `[warn] NMH not running` | Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent before launching. || `browser_navigation: 0` in chunk | Extension was loaded after portals were already open (content scripts didn't inject). Close Chrome, re-run — extension now loads at Chrome start. || Port 5122/5123/5124 already in use | Run `taskkill /F /IM python.exe` or restart. || `pyautogui` / `websocket` not found | `pip install pyautogui websocket-client` || GT log not found after run | Check `gt-logs/` in the theme_m1_data folder. Confirm the orchestrator didn't crash mid-run. |v介護休業申請を受理。期間: 2026-07-30 〜 2027-01-11。HW-2026-409と照合済。承認完了。----------------------------------------千葉金属工業へ PO-2026-469 に関する'数量変更依頼'を送付。回答待ち。----------------------------------------みずほ銀行 勘定照合 2026-05-W3。未達取引 TXN-490 を照合。仕訳 JV-20-330 で消込完了。----------------------------------------横浜精機へ PO-2026-544 に関する'納期回答依頼'を送付。回答待ち。----------------------------------------三井住友銀行 勘定照合 2026-05-W4。未達取引 TXN-843 を照合。仕訳 JV-37-265 で消込完了。----------------------------------------住民税通知書を受領。特別徴収額 31,700円/月を確認。前年比適正範囲内。確認済とする。----------------------------------------前年比 +7,400円の乖離を検知。東京都渋谷区へ確認票を送付し再計算を依頼する。担当：吉田 恵子。----------------------------------------北陸金属へ PO-2026-484 に関する'品質証明書督促'を送付。回答待ち。----------------------------------------オムロン株式会社 PM-175009-003 — 支払額 1,800,000円。支払期日 2026-07-11。保留事項あり。担当へ確認依頼。----------------------------------------入社予定者 森田 彩香（E1595）の書類照合完了。通勤手当 21,000円/月を給与マスタに登録。開発部配属。

One-time browser extension setupThe ProcMine browser extension captures browser navigation, clicks, and form inputs (L3 events). It must be loaded into each of the three Chrome portal windows once. After that it persists in the Chrome profiles stored at `theme_m1_data/chrome-profiles/` and loads automatically on every future run.**Step 1 — Get the extension**Download `procmine-extension-v1.0.0.zip` from the team drive and unzip it. Note the path to the unpacked folder (e.g. `C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension\`).**Step 2 — Run the one-time setup script**```powershellcd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation$chrome = "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"$base   = "$PSScriptRoot\..\..\chrome-profiles"   # created automatically$ext    = "C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension"  # your path# Kill any existing Chrome, then open one window per portaltaskkill /F /IM chrome.exe 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2foreach ($entry in @(    @{dir="m1-hr";      url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"},    @{dir="m1-finance"; url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"},    @{dir="m1-ops";     url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"})) {    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$base\$($entry.dir)" | Out-Null    Start-Process $chrome -ArgumentList "--user-data-dir=`"$base\$($entry.dir)`"","--no-first-run","--new-window",$entry.url    Start-Sleep 3}```> The portals won't load (no http.server running yet) — that's fine. You just need Chrome open with each profile.**Step 3 — Load the extension in each window**In each of the 3 Chrome windows:1. Open a new tab → navigate to `chrome://extensions`2. Enable **Developer mode** (toggle, top-right)3. Click **Load unpacked** → select the `procmine-extension` folder4. Confirm extension ID `gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn` appears5. Close the extensions tab**Step 4 — Close all Chrome windows**The extension is now saved to each profile. You're done — don't repeat this unless you delete `chrome-profiles/`.---## 3. Running a session**Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent first** and confirm it is recording.Then run either launcher:```powershell# PowerShell launcher (interactive prompts)cd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation.\launch_m1.ps1# Or Python launcher (same behaviour, cross-platform args)python scripts/run_theme_m1.pypython scripts/run_theme_m1.py --seed 42 --speed 1 --scale 2```### Run parameters| Prompt / Flag | Values | Default ||---|---|---|| Seed | Any integer | Random || Speed | `1` = fast (0.4×) · `2` = normal (1.4×) | `2` || Scale | `1` = 5–7 procs · `2` = 8–10 · `3` = 11–14 | `2` || Date | `YYYY-MM-DD` | Today |Pre-set with env vars to skip prompts:```powershell$env:M1_SEED = "42"; $env:M1_SPEED = "1"; $env:M1_SCALE = "2".\launch_m1.ps1```### What launches- 3 Python `http.server` instances (ports 5122 / 5123 / 5124)- Notepad- Excel with `documents/m1_reference.xlsx` (if available)- 3 Chrome windows (HR / Finance / Ops portals), each with CDP and ProcMine extension### Extension checkThe launcher prints one of:```[OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured``````[warn] Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: ...```If you see the warn, do the one-time extension setup (section 2) before continuing.---## 4. OutputAfter the run, GT logs land in:```Mixed/theme_m1_data/gt-logs/  theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl```Raw chunk arrives in S3 a few minutes after the session ends (desktop agent uploads asynchronously).---## 5.
